scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — base-game and early-game missing records

records.name: Saturday Crash
records.effect: Fires a fast tracking Ki blast that briefly paralyzes the opponent.

records.name: Consecutive Energy Blast
records.effect: Fires a tracking barrage of 10 Ki blasts.

records.name: Super Destructo-Disc
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 4 - Invasion of the Evil Super Namek
records.effect: Throws a fast tracking, unblockable Destructo-Disc with stronger damage than the standard version.

records.name: Earth Splitting Galick Gun
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 11 - Burst Open and Mix!
records.effect: Rapidly fires a large multi-hit Galick Gun beam; up to 23 hits.

reconciliation_note: All four names were absent from the repository's local docs/data/skills.json at audit time. Their current XV2 pages explicitly classify them as Ki Blast Supers and provide the listed costs/acquisition routes. Non-PQ routes are marked UF=false because an Ultimate Finish is not part of the acquisition method.
